run_plausible_pseudo_order_teacher: run the plausible pseudo order teacher to predict all player orders from dialogue chunks
register_plausible_pseudo_order_variants: register teacher variants like message_history_shortstate_plausiblepseudoorder_chunk for plausible order prediction tasks
configure_speaker_first_prediction: configure the --speaker-first flag to predict the speaker pseudo-order first instead of last
evaluate_all_order_predictions: evaluate all order predictions using AllOrderPredMetricMixin custom_evaluation for exact match and intersection metrics
extend_base_pseudoorder_teacher: extend BasePseudoorderDialogueChunkTeacher to create new plausible pseudo order dialogue chunk teachers
